title: Updating prompts in AF7
author: engineering-AF7
selftext:
This is an example of how prompt updating can be done in [alphaflowseven.com](http://alphaflowseven.com)

1. You select the model to use for prompt updating - AF7 will report the cost of this action back to you

2. You write the prompt describing what kind of change you want to make (in this case curing over-trading)

3. The new proposed prompt is presented alongside the current and you decide what edits to accept and not.
